context: Two teens hype each other up for a school sports day
purpose: Teach: もっぱら/それなのに/いやぁ/おもっ/しょっちゅう/時折/一口/出番

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: いやぁ、ついに体育祭の出番が来たね！緊張するけど楽しみ！
lines.en: Whew, the sports day is finally here! I'm nervous but excited!
lines.style: Excited and pumped-up teenage girl voice, slightly breathy with anticipation.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: わかる！桜、しょっちゅう放課後まで走り込んでたもんな。
lines.en: I know! Sakura, you were constantly doing extra runs after school.
lines.style: Energetic teen boy, admiring and friendly tone with rising energy.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うん、最近はもっぱら走ることばっかり考えてた。それなのに昨日の夜、緊張で全然眠れなくてさ。
lines.en: Yeah, lately I've been thinking pretty much only about running. And yet last night I couldn't sleep at all from nerves.
lines.style: Slightly vulnerable teen girl voice, softer with a nervous laugh underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 大丈夫だって！おまえずっと一位狙えるっておもってたぜ、俺は。
lines.en: You'll be fine! I've been thinking this whole time that you could grab first place.
lines.style: Reassuring teen boy, warm and confident, almost like a coach hyping his friend.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがと。私も時折弱気になるけど、今日は思いっきりやるよ。あ、このゼリー一口食べる？力出るよ。
lines.en: Thanks. I get weak-hearted every so often, but today I'm going all out. Oh, want a bite of this jelly? It gives you energy.
lines.style: Lighter, smiling teen girl voice, casual and caring between friends.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: サンキュー！よし、リレーでガツンと差をつけて、勢いつけようぜ！
lines.en: Thanks! Alright, let's open up a huge lead in the relay and build momentum!
lines.style: Fired-up teen boy shout, fists-clenched energy, locker room pep-talk style.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うん！リク、足の速さはあんたの長所なんだから、思いっきりいきな！
lines.en: Yeah! Riku, your speed is literally your strong point, so just go all out!
lines.style: Bright cheering teen girl, supportive with a playful punch-on-the-shoulder energy.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: おう！じゃあ次は俺の出番だ。行ってくる！
lines.en: You bet! Alright, I'm up next. I'm heading out there!
lines.style: Determined teen boy, short and punchy, voice rising as he runs off.
